entries.subject: NOIRLab noao-m101ubviha (Mayall 4-meter Mosaic)
entries.finding: The whole disc in U, B, V, I and H-alpha, 31.7 arcmin wide at 0.26 arcsec per pixel. The page's centre is wrong by 2577 and 1010 px; the registration is fitted to 41 Gaia stars.

entries.subject: ESA/Hubble heic0602a
entries.finding: The 15852 x 12392 px Hubble mosaic is far sharper but covers 13.2 x 10.3 arcmin of a disc 29 arcmin across, with ground-based images under its corners.
entries.revisitWhen: The bake composes a sharp inner image over a wide one, as M31's does.

entries.subject: Cepheids of M101 (Hoffmann et al. 2016; Shappee & Stanek 2011)
entries.finding: The SH0ES Cepheids of M101 have positions in CDS J/ApJ/830/10 table5, the table the Cepheid star packages of other hosts are drafted from. Not drawn as dots here: they would be the same stars a later star-package batch places.
entries.revisitWhen: M101's Cepheids are wanted as dots or as star packages.
